hints.title: Initial Product Sale Year Identification
hints.text: Retrieve product identifier, first year sold, quantity, and price for the earliest recorded sales year of each product.

hints.title: Composite Subquery Matching Earliest Year
hints.text: Filter Sales matching (product_id, year) in a subquery that groups Sales by product_id and finds min(year).

hints.title: First Year Sales Blueprint
hints.text: select product_id, year as first_year, quantity, price from Sales where (product_id, year) in (select product_id, min(year) from Sales group by product_id).

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT product_id, year AS first_year, quantity, price
FROM Sales
WHERE (product_id, year) IN (
    SELECT product_id, MIN(year)
    FROM Sales
    GROUP BY product_id
);
```

variables: S: number of records in Sales table
complexity.notes: Subquery aggregation and tuple filtering execute in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Grouping directly by product_id and selecting quantity returns arbitrary rows in standard SQL.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Subquery tuple matching isolates exact matching transactions per product.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of composite tuple subquery IN (SELECT product_id, MIN(year)) or DENSE_RANK().

import pandas as pd

def sales_analysis(sales: pd.DataFrame, product: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    min_years = sales.groupby('product_id')['year'].transform('min')
    first_sales = sales[sales['year'] == min_years].copy()
    first_sales = first_sales.rename(columns={'year': 'first_year'})
    return first_sales[['product_id', 'first_year', 'quantity', 'price']]
